👻 MiniPacman

Guide Pac-Man through a maze packed with pellets while evading four colorful ghosts — each with their own patrol behavior. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Use arrow keys to navigate Pac-Man through the maze corridors.
  2. Eat all the small pellets to complete the level — each is worth points.
  3. Eat the large power pellets to temporarily turn ghosts blue and chomp them.
  4. Avoid the ghosts when they are their normal color — they end your game on contact.
  5. Use tunnel wraps on the sides of the maze to escape tight situations.
